Samira: quick follow-up from tonight's all-hands re: promotion timing — when do midcycle promos actually get applied?
Priya K: short answer: effective date depends on approval type. retention promos may be retro by up to one pay period; standard approvals take effect on approval date.
Owen: can managers file exceptions after packet close? have a candidate who surfaced late.
Priya K: yes, use the post-calibration exception flow and include manager rationale + skip-level note. those are for exceptional cases only.
Nina: curious about communication: is there a recommended script for denied promos so managers don't overpromise?
Priya K: yes, we have a got-it script in the guide. short version: explain artifacts reviewed, give concrete growth goals, set a 3-6 month re-review plan, and log everything in Lattice.
People Ops Bot: Office hours tomorrow 10am PT for managers — calendar invite posted in #calendar.
Samira: thanks — will prep materials.
Priya K: thanks all, post any follow-ups here or bring to office hours.
